errors.evidence: The description swaps the colors/years for the values of "Картофи". According to the legend, orange is 2023 and blue is 2022. The chart shows the orange bar (2023) is at approx. 7000 ha, and the blue bar (2022) is at approx. 9200 ha. The description incorrectly associates 2023 with the orange bar and 2022 with the blue bar, which contradicts the legend.
